learningGoals: Observe how shadows change size and direction based on light. ☀️
Understand the sequence of daily routines (morning, afternoon, evening). ⏰
Measure lengths using non-standard units like handspans and footsteps. 👣
Relate the concept of time to everyday activities. 📅
teachingTips: Take your child outside at different times of the day to see how their shadow changes length. 🌞
Use handspans to measure the length of a table or books together. 👐
Discuss the logical order of daily events (e.g., 'First we wake up, then we brush, then we eat breakfast'). 🥣
Read bedtime stories and ask your child to sequence what happened first, next, and last. 📖

funActivities.title: Shadow Puppets 🐕
funActivities.description: Use your hands and a flashlight in a dark room to make fun shadow animals on the wall.

funActivities.title: Measure My Room 📏
funActivities.description: Ask your child to measure the length of their bedroom by counting their footsteps.

funActivities.title: My Day in Drawings 🖍️
funActivities.description: Have your child draw three pictures: one thing they do in the morning, afternoon, and night.
